_source: World Bank, World Development Indicators, PA.NUS.FCRF 'Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)', https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/MNG/indicator/PA.NUS.FCRF (series last updated 2026-10-08, retrieved 2026-10-23). Used to show US$ beside an expenditure review's own currency where the review gives no rate of its own (Mongolia). Sri Lanka's review states its own annual rates and those are used instead; Panama's balboa is pegged to the US$ at par.
